name: gh-trading-terminal
description: GitHub contributions as a Bloomberg/TradingView-style candlestick terminal. Zero-dependency SVG for profile READMEs.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js --user octocat --demo --out dist/demo-dark.svg && node src/cli.js --user octocat --demo --theme light --out dist/demo-light.svg
scripts.previews: node src/cli.js --user octocat --demo --out assets/preview-dark.svg && node src/cli.js --user octocat --demo --theme bloomberg --days 180 --out assets/preview-bloomberg.svg
